item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"C1","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"The answer should precompute the expected chat messages from an explicit adapter using the same signature and concrete input kwargs that the real `Predict` call will send, instead of hand-writing a prompt approximation.","span_ids":["S2","S3"]},{"claim_id":"C2","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"The offline render should match the runtime demo context;
